reason: Touches core transaction/session lifecycle paths (`pkg/session`, `pkg/sessionctx`, `pkg/store/driver/txn`, `pkg/kv`) to coordinate background commit goroutines. Even if framed as hooks/waiting logic, changes around async/background commit completion can affect commit visibility, session shutdown semantics, and KV correctness, which are central and high-blast-radius enough to justify a blocker/high-focused review.
